claim: Evidence gaps and caveats for this literature review. It used only 3 web searches, with no OpenAlex or arXiv API queries, and I read only snippets, not full papers. I found no source reporting a per-defect-type breakdown of what LLM agents miss compared with axe-core. The only direct head-to-head found is arXiv 2609.09379, and it covers 15 criteria with inferred negatives. Most axe-core miss-rate figures come from vendor claims or blogs: the Deque 57%, the Evinced study, and the GDS and Abbott figures reported secondhand. Reported coverage varies widely, from about 22% to 57%, depending on how it is measured (issues vs criteria, page types). A systematic review of LLMs for web accessibility (arXiv 2605.13873) exists and was not read; it is worth mining next.
evidence: Search limitations: only snippets retrieved this session
Related Work notes that traditional tools often fail on semantic or context-dependent criteria [21-12]
